basic_info.description:
Welcome to this charming 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home, located in the vibrant city of San Francisco. It is situated on a wide street at the foot of Golden Gate Heights and the renowned Moraga steps. An ideal location in the heart of Inner Sunset with easy access to transportation and in close proximity to local restaurants, coffee shops, and Golden Gate Park. This lovely property spans 1,715 sqft and is situated on a 2,199 sqft lot. It features a spacious living/dining room combo, bathed in natural sunlight with spectacular views of the ocean. Enjoy the warmth and ambiance of the central fireplace in the living area, perfect for those cooler San Francisco evenings. The well-designed kitchen, airy and bright, with oceanviews, offers ample space for culinary enthusiasts. Lower level includes a den/office and a rumpus room with new carpets and good size closets. Additional amenities include a convenient laundry area and a spacious 2-car garage.  
This property with its stylish look combines comfort, practicality, and the quintessential San Francisco lifestyle, making it an ideal place to call home.
